FlixBus	₹359 onwards	Exact departure/boarding point, included baggage, cancellation/refund fee, final payment total. 
FlixBus India

redBus

Here are three India-available options to shortlist:

MakeMyTrip – Epic Kerala: ₹13,718/person, 4N/5D; Munnar–Thekkady–Alleppey, 3/4-star hotels, intercity transfers, airport pickup/drop and selected meals. 
MakeMyTrip

TravelTriangle – Charismatic Kerala: ₹13,642/person, 4N/5D; 3-star hotels, breakfast, sightseeing and transfers. Mumbai departure package. 
TravelTriangle.com

Honor Tour & Travels – Kerala Highlights: ₹35,000/person, 4N/5D; Kochi–Munnar–Thekkady–Alleppey, hotels, meals, transfers and tour manager. Mumbai departures available. 
Honor Tour & Travels

Before paying: verify whether flights/train are included (often they aren't), exact hotel names, transfer type, GST, and written cancellation/refund terms. Honor’s published sample policy can retain 25%+ from 60 days out and 100% within 15 days; final terms must be confirmed at booking. 
Honor Tour & Travels
